data.explanation: This invoice asks you to pay €1,400.00 toward your new hearing aids, since your statutory health insurance already covered its fixed share. The amount is due by the deadline shown in the app, calculated from the invoice date. If you cannot pay in full, you can contact the shop to arrange installments, as the letter offers. Keep this invoice, as such medical costs may be deductible on your tax return. If you have questions about what your insurance should have covered, you can ask your Krankenkasse or the shop directly.
